pending.title: #TSLA SELL SIGNAL VS. $365.31 REVERSAL — KEY LEVELS INTO THE FED #Tesla #daytrading
pending.description:
Please ❤️like and 🔁share with fellow Tesla traders/investors

#Tesla closed Tuesday at $356.58 heading into a potentially volatile Fed day. The technical picture remains bearish, but there’s now a very clear level that could flip the short-term setup.

*

A couple of months ago, #TSLA closed below the bottom of its 18-month rising channel, triggering a long-term sell signal that remains active with a $228.83 objective over the broader 3–5 month window. 

We’re already roughly two months into that signal without major downside follow-through, however.

Instead, TSLA initially sold off, found support near $285, and then rallied all the way back to retest the broken long-term channel bottom around $389.75. That level is now major resistance.

*

More recently, Tesla broke another important structure: a six-week rising channel. 

The settlement below $363.64 earlier this week triggered a fresh intermediate-term sell signal and shifted the 3–5 week target back toward $285.

The downside roadmap now looks like this: $347.40 is the immediate target and potential daily support.

A close below $347.40 opens the door to $330.48, potentially within 3–5 trading days. That 5/8 Fibonacci level could absorb both daily and weekly selling pressure.

If $330.48 eventually breaks on a settlement basis, the next major objective becomes $285 over the following 2–3 weeks. That’s meaningful monthly support where Tesla could potentially establish a more substantial bottom.

Below $285 on a monthly basis, however, and the larger $228.83 long-term objective comes back into focus.

*

But there’s an important bullish alternative.

$363.64, the broken six-week channel bottom, is now resistance, while $365.31 is the key short-term reversal point.

A close above $365.31 would represent a significant short-term reversal and flip the 3–5 day swing setup bullish, targeting a retest of $389.75 potentially by the end of next week.

*

So the technical battle is increasingly straightforward:
– Below $363.64–$365.31: bearish structure remains intact, with $347.40, $330.48 and ultimately $285 in play.
– Close above $365.31: short-term reversal signal, with $389.75 becoming the upside target.

At ~$358 pre-market, Tesla is sitting almost directly between these two scenarios.

And today is Fed day, so anything can happen. 

The initial reaction may be less important than where #TSLA ultimately closes. 

Watch $363.64–$365.31 above and $347.40 below. Those levels should tell us whether the recent sell signal remains in control or Tesla is setting up another run toward $389.75.

*

If you enjoyed this update, please 👍🏻 like and 🔁 share
